body: Commit d3e95d9 on VectorCraft's hooks branch (worktree .claude/worktrees/agent-a2162264098c60ec2). After each review, before its checkout is removed, the hook stops every broker whose --cwd is that checkout: broker/shutdown on its socket (2 s), then TERM of the whole tree from one ps snapshot, 2 s, then KILL. `codex-review reap` (also at runner start) stops brokers whose .../vc-review-*/tree is gone and nothing else. To copy: change the reap prefix to bil-review-*, and keep the path normalization ($TMPDIR ends in '/', so mktemp's double-slash path never matched node's /private form). Tests: 116 ok, 4 fail on the old hook. Under branch review; lands after Star Castle and #42, main hash to follow.
